questions.statement: This animal lives on a farm. It gives us milk and it says "moo". What is it?
questions.context: En una finca de Boyacá, la familia de Andrés ordeña una vaca cada mañana para tener leche.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A dog is a pet that says "woof"; people do not get milk from a dog.
Correct. A cow is the farm animal that gives milk and says "moo".
Incorrect. A hen is a farm bird that lays eggs and says "cluck", so it does not give milk.
Incorrect. A horse is a farm animal that people ride; it says "neigh", not "moo".

questions.explanation: Repasamos los animales de granja. La "cow" (vaca) vive en la finca, nos da leche ("milk") y hace "moo". La gallina ("hen") da huevos y el caballo ("horse") sirve para montar.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read the dialogue.
Teacher: "Do you have a pet, Mariana?"
Mariana: "Yes, I have a ___. It says 'meow'."
questions.context: Mariana vive en un apartamento en Pereira y tiene una mascota que duerme en el sofá.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A duck is a farm bird and its sound is "quack", not "meow".
Incorrect. A pig lives on a farm and says "oink", so it does not match "meow".
Correct. A cat is a pet and the sound a cat makes is "meow".
Incorrect. A rabbit can be a pet, but it hops and eats carrots; it does not say "meow".

questions.explanation: Para completar el diálogo hay que relacionar el sonido con el animal. El sonido "meow" es del gato, "cat". El pato ("duck") hace "quack" y el cerdo ("pig") hace "oink".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: This big wild cat lives in the Amazon jungle. It is yellow with black spots and it is a very fast hunter. What is it?
questions.context: En la selva del Amazonas, cerca de Leticia, vive un gran felino que caza de noche.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A zebra has black and white stripes, not spots, and it eats grass in Africa.
Incorrect. A sheep is a farm animal with white wool; it is not a wild hunter.
Incorrect. A parrot is a colorful bird with wings; it is not a big cat with spots.
Correct. The jaguar is the big wild cat of the Amazon, yellow with black spots.

questions.explanation: El "jaguar" es un animal salvaje ("wild animal") que vive en la selva colombiana. Es amarillo con manchas negras ("black spots"). La cebra tiene rayas ("stripes") y la oveja vive en la granja.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence: "A snake is a long animal. It has no ___."
questions.context: En una clase en Villavicencio, los niños miran fotos de una serpiente del Llano.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A snake has two eyes to see, so "no eyes" is false.
Incorrect. A snake has a mouth to eat, so "no mouth" is false.
Correct. A snake has no legs; it moves on its belly.
Incorrect. A snake has skin with scales, so "no skin" is false.

questions.explanation: La serpiente ("snake") no tiene patas: "It has no legs". Sí tiene ojos ("eyes"), boca ("mouth") y piel con escamas ("skin"). Por eso la única palabra que completa bien la oración es "legs".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Sofia buys a fruit at the market. It is yellow and sweet. It has green leaves on top, like a crown." What does Sofia buy?
questions.context: Sofia hace mercado con su mamá en la galería Alameda de Cali.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A lemon is small and sour, and it has no crown of leaves on top.
Correct. A pineapple is yellow, sweet and has green leaves on top like a crown.
Incorrect. A watermelon is green outside and red inside, and it has no crown.
Incorrect. A grape is very small and grows in groups; it has no leaves like a crown.

questions.explanation: Hay que usar todas las pistas: amarilla, dulce ("sweet") y con hojas verdes arriba como una corona ("crown"). Esa fruta es la piña, "pineapple". El limón ("lemon") es ácido y la sandía ("watermelon") es roja por dentro.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Leo makes a salad with lettuce, onion and one more vegetable. It is long and orange. Rabbits love it." What is the vegetable?
questions.context: Leo prepara una ensalada para el almuerzo en su casa de Tunja.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A potato is a brown, round vegetable, not long and orange.
Incorrect. A cucumber is long, but it is green, not orange.
Incorrect. A strawberry is a small red fruit, not a long orange vegetable.
Correct. A carrot is a long orange vegetable and rabbits love to eat it.

questions.explanation: La verdura es larga ("long") y naranja ("orange"), y a los conejos les encanta: es la zanahoria, "carrot". El pepino ("cucumber") también es largo pero es verde, y la fresa ("strawberry") es una fruta.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Juan gets up at six. He takes a shower and gets dressed. Then he has breakfast and goes to school." What does Juan do BEFORE he has breakfast?
questions.context: Juan estudia en un colegio de Manizales y cuenta su rutina de la mañana.

options.feedback: Correct. The text says he gets dressed and then he has breakfast, so dressing comes first.
Incorrect. He goes to school after breakfast, as the word "then" in the text shows.
Incorrect. The text describes the morning; going to bed happens at night and is not mentioned.
Incorrect. Homework is not part of the text, so we cannot say he does it before breakfast.

questions.explanation: La palabra "before" significa "antes de". En el texto, Juan se levanta, se baña y se viste ("gets dressed") y luego ("then") desayuna. Ir al colegio ocurre después del desayuno, no antes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read the dialogue.
Mom: "It is eight o'clock at night. What do you do now?"
Ana: "___"
questions.context: Son las ocho de la noche en la casa de Ana en Neiva y su mamá le pregunta qué hace.

options.text: I brush my teeth and go to bed.
options.feedback: Correct. At night, before sleeping, people brush their teeth and go to bed.

options.text: I wake up and eat breakfast.
options.feedback: Incorrect. We wake up and eat breakfast in the morning, not at eight at night.

options.text: I go to school by bus.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Children go to school in the morning, so this does not fit eight at night.
Incorrect. Lunch is at midday, around twelve, not at eight o'clock at night.

questions.explanation: La pista es "at night" (de noche). La respuesta debe ser una actividad nocturna: "brush my teeth" (cepillarse los dientes) y "go to bed" (irse a dormir). Desayunar o ir al colegio son actividades de la mañana.
questions.subject: ingles
